label: prerequisites
command: /bin/bash -lc 'uname -a; sw_vers; arch; git --version; node --version 2>&1 || true; npm --version 2>&1 || true; pnpm --version 2>&1 || true; python3 --version; go version 2>&1 || true; java -version 2>&1 || true; php -v 2>&1 | head -n 1 || true; docker --version 2>&1 || true; df -h .'

label: repo-metadata
command:
/bin/bash -lc 'for r in activepieces nango twenty unomi openfga klaro dedupe opencats frappe-hr; do p="repos/$r"; printf "%s," "$r"; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD | tr -d "
"; printf ","; git -C "$p" show -s --format=%cI HEAD | tr -d "
"; printf ","; git -C "$p" describe --tags --exact-match 2>/dev/null | tr -d "
" || true; printf ","; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD^{tree} | tr -d "
"; printf ","; git -C "$p" archive HEAD | shasum -a 256 | cut -d " " -f 1 | tr -d "
"; printf ","; du -sk "$p" | cut -f 1; done'

label: nango_npm_metadata
command: npm view nango version dist.tarball license --json

label: lab_disk_before
command: du -sh . repos envs fixtures artifacts logs

label: final_disk_profile
command: du -sk . repos/activepieces repos/nango repos/twenty repos/unomi repos/openfga repos/klaro repos/dedupe repos/opencats repos/frappe-hr envs/nango-cli fixtures/nango-smoke envs/dedupe artifacts/openfga_1.18.1_darwin_arm64.tar.gz artifacts/openfga_1.18.1_darwin_arm64.tar.gz.sbom.json
